metadata.name: fairdrum
metadata.description: FAIRDRUM: an open drum game on Solana

instructions.name: accept_dev_authority
docs: Changing the administrator key, step 2: the new key confirms it itself — this way the rights cannot be handed to a keyless address by mistake.
If the launch fund was under the same key, it moves along with it.

instructions.name: accept_root_authority
docs: Hand-over of the root authority, step 2: the new key confirms it itself, so the right cannot be handed to a keyless
address by a typo (after the program is closed that would stop the game for good when the secrets run out).

instructions.name: checkin
docs: "I am human": a day check-in without a spin. Extends the streak.

instructions.name: claim_dev
docs: Administrator's share: 10% of paid bets, accumulates in dev_pool (dev_authority).

instructions.name: deposit_sweep
docs: Credit SOL from the player's personal deposit address to their game balance. The address is derived from the player's wallet,
nobody holds a key to it; SOL can be sent to it from anywhere (an exchange, another wallet). Anyone can send
the command — it can do only one thing: move SOL from the owner's address to that same owner's balance.
The sender of the command is reimbursed the network fee; if the player's wallet is empty, a small part goes to it for fees.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Whoever sent the command (the keeper, the player's site or anyone): they are reimbursed the network fee

accounts.name: deposit
docs: Personal deposit address: a regular system account at an address derived from the player's wallet

accounts.name: player
docs: Player account: if it does not exist yet, it is created by this same crediting (the sender pays, the cost is reimbursed from the deposit)

instructions.name: donate
docs: Contribute one's own funds to the jackpot seed reserve (anyone can). They cannot be taken back:
from the reserve funds go only into the jackpot pots, that is, to players.

instructions.name: fund_pools
docs: After the tokens have been sent to the vault. Anyone can call it, once.

instructions.name: guard_pause
docs: The guardian (or the administrator) pauses acceptance of NEW bets. Only the administrator can lift the pause.
Settlements, payouts and withdrawals do not depend on the pause.

instructions.name: init_unwrap
docs: Once after the upgrade: create the service account of wrapped SOL for `withdraw_sol`. Administrator only (audit No. 10,
P10-3): this is the switch that turns `withdraw_sol` on, and it must stay in the owner's hands until the instruction has been
rehearsed on the mainnet token program. The administrator pays the network's rent deposit ≈0.00204 SOL; the account's address
and owner are set by the program and cannot be chosen. Until the account is created, `withdraw_sol` is rejected and
the previous `withdraw` works as before.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The administrator: only they can turn `withdraw_sol` on; pays the rent deposit of the service account

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Once, only by the holder of the program's upgrade authority. The game currency is wrapped SOL: the mint passed here
must be the native mint (checked below).

accounts.name: program_data
docs: Only whoever holds the upgrade authority of THIS program can set the launch parameters (protection against front-running).
The address of the program data account is computed from the program id: otherwise one could slip in
a foreign program whose authority belongs to the attacker and take over the launch before the owner.

instructions.name: promo_pay
docs: Payout from the promotion fund (invitations, monthly ranking, advertising). Every payout is public.

instructions.name: propose_dev_authority
docs: Changing the administrator key, step 1: the current key names the new one. Pubkey::default() cancels the proposal.

instructions.name: propose_root_authority
docs: Hand-over of the root authority, step 1: the current root authority names the new key. Pubkey::default() cancels.

instructions.name: register
docs: Registration: open to everyone right after launch. The game has no invitations or referrals.

instructions.name: rescale_pools
docs: Move of the administrator's funds from the seed reserve into the games' prize bank; moving into the pots is not allowed (administrator only).

instructions.name: roll_epoch
docs: Once a week updates the weekly spin statistics. Moves no funds (the bank's surplus is released by settlements, not here). Called automatically on spins.

instructions.name: session_close
docs: Close a session early: the account rent is returned to the owner.

instructions.name: session_open
docs: Open (or reissue) a game session: with one signature the owner allows a temporary
key to make spins on their behalf — for no longer than secs seconds and no more than limit tokens of bets.
A session key cannot withdraw, deposit or change the wallet: only commit spins.

accounts.name: player
docs: Only a registered player can open a session

instructions.name: set_guardian
docs: Appoint a "guardian" (administrator only): a key that can only pause acceptance of new bets.

instructions.name: set_house_root
docs: Set the root of the house secret tree. Applies to SUBSEQUENT bets: every bet already
placed has its own root recorded in its account, and a new root does not affect it. Needed at launch, when the secrets
are running out, and if the secrets file may have fallen into the wrong hands.
Who signs (exactly one party at any time; never the administrator: upgrade No. 2, audit No. 10, P10-1):
* the `RootAuth` account EXISTS (created by `set_root_authority`): only the root authority recorded in it. The upgrade
authority is then refused here, and the program data account is not read at all, so this path does not depend on the
upgrade authority or on the loader in any way and keeps working after the upgrade authority is revoked;
* the `RootAuth` account does not exist: the holder of the program's upgrade authority, as before. If the upgrade
authority is revoked in THAT state, the root can never be changed again (bets stop when the secrets run out).
Whoever sets the root knows the secrets of every later round and can settle rounds selectively.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The root authority if the `RootAuth` account exists, otherwise the holder of the program's upgrade authority

accounts.name: program_data
docs: id, owner = the upgradeable loader, recorded authority = the signer) ONLY while the `RootAuth` account does not exist;
once it exists this account is ignored, so nothing here depends on the loader after the program is closed.

accounts.name: root_auth
docs: exists (is owned by this program) and what it says is checked in the instruction.

instructions.name: set_jackpot_starts
docs: Starting amounts of the jackpot and the super jackpot (administrator only): a pot is topped up to them from the reserve after a win.
They take effect after 24 hours; bets placed earlier are settled at the previous amounts.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Pause or resume acceptance of NEW bets (administrator only) — in case of a failure or an incident.
Bets already placed are settled as usual; payouts and withdrawals do not depend on the pause.

instructions.name: set_root_authority
docs: Name the ROOT AUTHORITY: the dedicated key that alone may set the secrets root from now on (see `set_house_root`).
Signed by the holder of the program's upgrade authority; creates the `RootAuth` account or replaces the key in it (and
cancels a pending hand-over). Possible only while an upgrade authority exists: after it is revoked the key changes only
by the two-step hand-over below. The key cannot be empty or coincide with the administrator, the proposed administrator,
the launch-fund key or the guardian: the root authority must be a key that can do nothing else.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The holder of the program's upgrade authority; pays the rent of the record when it is created

instructions.name: spin_commit
docs: Round step 1: the bet is debited, the round gets the next house secret number, the bet's block and
the secret root in effect are remembered. Nobody knows the outcome at this moment: the secret is not yet revealed and the block is not yet closed.

accounts.name: user
docs: Signer: the player's owner or their session key

accounts.name: session
docs: Session: required only when a session key signs

instructions.name: spin_expire
docs: Refund of the bet for a round the house did not complete. Two cases:
* the round was neither settled nor sealed while the hash of the bet's block was available (≈3.5 minutes) — it will never have an outcome;
* the round is sealed, but the house did not reveal its secret for 24 hours.
The bet is returned in full to the game balance. Anyone can call it. The player cannot influence this: they do not know
the secret and cannot obstruct settlement. Every refund increments the public counter Config.refunds.

instructions.name: spin_seal
docs: Seal a round: record the hash of the bet's block while it is available (≈3.5 minutes after the bet). Anyone can call it,
any number of times: the value is uniquely determined by the bet's block. Needed if settlement is delayed (the house
keeper is unavailable): a sealed round can be settled later, an unsealed one cannot. Usually settlement seals it itself.

instructions.name: spin_settle
docs: Step 2: settlement. The caller (usually the house keeper) reveals the round secret and the path to the root; the contract checks
the secret against the root recorded at bet time, mixes it with the hash of the bet's block and computes the outcome. The secret cannot be swapped:
only one fits the root. After the round's deadline (≈20 minutes) the pots are no longer played in it: this way the owner
of the secret cannot wait for a pot to grow.

instructions.name: withdraw_sol
docs: Withdrawal in regular SOL — without "wrapped SOL" in the player's wallet (upgrade No. 2, change C; site audit S9-01).
The previous `withdraw` command pays to the player's token account, which the site must first create for ~0.00204 SOL from
the player's wallet; a built-in wallet may not have those funds. Here the player needs only the network fee.
The accounting, the withdrawal rules and the vault protection are the same as for `withdraw` (the same `engine::withdraw`, the same `solvent`).
Only the delivery of the funds differs: vault → service account of wrapped SOL (its owner is the config account) →
closing the service account into the player's wallet (this turns wrapped SOL into regular SOL) → the service account is re-created
on the rent deposit the player returned. All in one command: either the player received exactly `net` in regular SOL and the service account
is empty and ready again, or nothing changed.

accounts.name: user
docs: Player: signs and receives regular SOL

accounts.name: mint
docs: The game currency is wrapped SOL (this was already checked at launch, in initialize); here the check is repeated explicitly

accounts.name: unwrap_account
docs: Service account of wrapped SOL: the address is derived from the program, the owner is the config account

errors.name: VaultUnderfunded
errors.msg: Vault holds less than the launch parameters require

errors.name: NotStarted
errors.msg: The game has not started yet

errors.name: NoFreeSpins
errors.msg: No free spins left this week

errors.name: SpinPending
errors.msg: Previous round is not settled yet

errors.name: SettleTooEarly
errors.msg: Too early: wait for the next slot

errors.name: WithdrawLocked
errors.msg: Withdrawal is locked after a recent deposit

errors.name: NotSealed
errors.msg: Round was not sealed in time

errors.name: SolvencyGuard
errors.msg: Solvency guard: vault would not cover obligations

errors.name: BadProof
errors.msg: Round secret does not match the committed root

errors.name: HouseExhausted
errors.msg: Round secrets are not set or exhausted

errors.name: NotRootAuthority
errors.msg: Only the root authority can do this

docs: Administrator action: kind 1 — collected the share (a = amount), 2 — new starting amounts (a = jackpot, b = super),
3 — move from the reserve to the prize bank (a = amount), 4 — bet pause (a = 1/0), 5 — new key proposed, 6 — key changed,
7 — guardian appointed, 8 — guardian paused bets, 9 — new secret root set (a = depth, b = from which bet),
10 — root authority named by the upgrade authority (key = the root authority), 11 — hand-over of the root authority
proposed (key = the proposed key, zero = cancelled), 12 — root authority handed over (key = the new root authority)
types.name: AdminAction

docs: The bank's surplus moved to the seed reserve at the end of a settlement (the rule of `consts::bank_release`): `amount`
lamports left the prize bank; `prize_pool` and `seed_reserve` are the two pools after the move. Written only when
something moved, after SpinSettled.
types.name: BankReleased

fields.name: registered
docs: Last issued registration number

fields.name: super_pool
docs: Super jackpot (accumulates for a long time, see consts.rs)

fields.name: super_unlock_ts
docs: No chance of the super jackpot before this time
Left over from the old super model with a time lock; always equals start_ts, not read (AUDIT O14)

fields.name: staked_total
docs: sum of paid bets over all time

fields.name: paid_total
docs: credited to players over all time: prizes and pots (including jackpot parts not yet paid out)

fields.name: dev_total
docs: credited to the administrator over all time

fields.name: wins
docs: recent pot wins, circular; the next one is written to slot wins_head

fields.name: pending_dev
docs: New administrator key proposed by the current one; takes effect when the new key confirms it itself (accept_dev_authority)

fields.name: paused
docs: Acceptance of new bets is paused. Settlements, payouts and withdrawals do not depend on this flag.

fields.name: guardian
docs: "Guardian": a key that can do only ONE thing — pause acceptance of new bets (not lift the pause, and nothing else).
The keeper holds it to stop bets on its own if the vault holds less than the obligations.

fields.name: owed
docs: Obligations to players: the sum of game balances, frozen jackpot parts and bets of unfinished rounds.
Maintained on every change of a player account; the contract uses it to check that the vault covers everything it owes.

fields.name: house_root
docs: "Fair draw": the root of the tree of house secrets created in advance. Each round's secret is revealed at settlement
and checked against this root, so it cannot be swapped after the bet.

fields.name: house_depth
docs: tree depth (it holds 2^depth secrets); 0 — the root is not set yet, bets are not accepted

fields.name: house_start
docs: number of the bet from which the current root took effect

fields.name: round_counter
docs: running bet counter: each bet gets the next secret number

fields.name: house_prev
docs: the eight previous secret roots: none of them can be set again (their secrets have already been revealed)

fields.name: house_prev_head
docs: where in house_prev to write the next previous root

fields.name: refunds
docs: how many rounds were closed by a bet refund (the house did not complete the round) — a public reliability indicator
Crediting from the personal deposit address: amount — to the game balance, drip — to the player's wallet for network fees
types.name: DepositSwept

docs: the game account was created by this same crediting (the network's rent for the record was reimbursed to the sender from the deposit)
fields.name: created

types.name: InitParams
docs: Launch parameters. Set once in initialize and never changed by anyone afterwards.

fields.name: start_ts
docs: Time from which spinning is allowed (registration is open right after launch)

fields.name: last_deposit_ts
docs: Time of the last deposit (Unix sec.) — for reference. The withdrawal lock is computed from dep_locked / dep_unlock_ts.
The field occupies the place of the former week_idx (weeks of free spins, which no longer exist): the mode is packed into the upper bits of p_n.

fields.name: p_root
docs: Root of the house secret tree in effect at the moment of the bet (32 bytes, stored as a key). The round secret
is checked against it: nobody can change the secrets of a bet already placed.

fields.name: p_leaf
docs: Number of this round's secret in the house secret tree (the ordinal of the bet since the root was set).

fields.name: p_start_jackpot
docs: Starting amounts of the jackpot and the super jackpot in effect at the moment of the bet: this round's chances are computed from them.
The administrator cannot change the chances of a bet already placed (audit of 11.11.2026, K1).

fields.name: p_prize_cap
docs: cap of a single prize, fixed at the moment of the bet (a quarter of the prize bank at that moment)

fields.name: p_salt
docs: The round's "salt": the hash of the block in which the bet is recorded. Nobody knows it at bet time (the block is not yet closed),
so the outcome cannot be computed in advance even knowing the round secret.

fields.name: p_sealed
docs: the salt is recorded (by the spin_seal command or by the settlement itself)

fields.name: dep_locked
docs: The withdrawal lock applies only to the DEPOSITED amount: this much of the balance cannot be withdrawn before dep_unlock_ts.
Winnings and everything above this amount can be withdrawn immediately.

fields.name: dep_unlock_ts
docs: When the lock is lifted (Unix sec.). A new deposit shifts the term in proportion to its share of the frozen
amount: someone else's "penny" sent to the deposit address barely changes the term.

types.name: RootAuth
docs: Root authority: the dedicated key that alone sets the root of the house secrets once this account exists (`set_house_root`).
It has no other right in the program. A separate small account at the address derived from the word "root-auth": the layout
of `Config`, `Player` and `Session` is not touched. Created (and, while an upgrade authority exists, replaced) by
`set_root_authority`; handed over by the key itself in two steps. There is no instruction that closes this account.

fields.name: authority
docs: The key that signs `set_house_root`

fields.name: pending
docs: Proposed next key (zero = no hand-over in progress); it takes over by signing `accept_root_authority`
Inputs of a round's settlement (upgrade No. 2): together with the round number from RoundRevealed this is enough to recompute
every outcome and every amount of the round bit for bit (recompute-v2). Written in the same transaction, before the settlement.
Amounts are in lamports. `mode` — the game (0…15), `n` — the number of paid bets, `late` — settlement past the deadline (the pots do not pay).
`prize_cap`, `start_jackpot`, `start_super` are recorded at bet time; the pools and `init_*` are the config state at the start of the settlement
(`init_*` — the starting amounts in effect in this settlement, taking a pending change into account if it is due).
types.name: RoundInputs

docs: Round reveal: with these three values anyone can verify the round number.
number = sha256("fairdrum-round-salt-v1", secret, salt); secret is checked against the root `root` (leaf number `leaf`).
types.name: RoundRevealed
Session
docs: Game session (owner's decision of 11.11.2026): a temporary key that the owner has allowed, once,
to make spins on their behalf — without a wallet window for every spin.
The key lives in the player's browser; the contract limits it by a lifetime and a bet budget.
This key cannot withdraw tokens, change the wallet or spend beyond the limit.

fields.name: limit
docs: Remaining bet budget in minimal units; every commit reduces it by the bet amount
the house did not complete the round: the bet was returned to the game balance in full
fields.name: refunded

types.name: WinRec
docs: Record of a pot win: who, how much, when. kind: 1 mini jackpot, 2 jackpot, 3 super jackpot; 0 — empty slot.
